title: One Model, Multiple Compute Budgets: Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE for Flexible Compute Across Turns
abstract: arXiv:2610.14074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models typically support different inference budgets through separate model sizes or fixed compute configurations. In multi-turn interactions, however, compute demand can vary substantially across turns. Using a high-compute model for every turn wastes computation, while routing among independent models may require rebuilding model-specific history states after switches. We therefore ask whether a single shared model can support multiple compute budgets that can be flexibly assigned across turns. We introduce Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE, which jointly supports token-to-concept compression ratios of 2, 4, and 8 (CR2/CR4/CR8) within a shared backbone. Lightweight full-token modules reduce compression-independent cost, ratio-specific boundary routers support distinct compression levels, and cross-ratio training enables mixed-ratio processing within the same context. translated_title: 一个模型，多个计算预算：用于跨轮次灵活计算的多种压缩比ConceptMoE
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通常通过独立的模型规模或固定的计算配置来支持不同的推理预算。然而，在多轮交互中，各轮次的计算需求可能存在很大差异。每一轮都使用高计算量模型会浪费计算资源，而在独立模型之间进行路由切换后，可能需要重建特定模型的历史状态。因此，我们探讨一个单一共享模型能否支持多个可在各轮次间灵活分配的计算预算。我们提出了Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE，它在共享骨干网络中同时支持2、4、8三种token到概念的压缩比（CR2/CR4/CR8）。轻量级全token模块降低了与压缩无关的开销，针对特定压缩比的边界路由器支持不同的压缩级别，而跨压缩比训练使同一上下文中能够进行混合压缩比处理。在PTBench和SFTBench上，三种固定模式的表现优于……（摘要原文截断于此）
tldr: 提出Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE，在单一共享模型内同时支持2/4/8三种token-概念压缩比计算预算，可在多轮对话中按轮灵活分配计算量，避免计算浪费和切换模型后历史状态的重建。
en_tdlr: Proposes Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE, a single shared model that supports three token-to-concept compression ratios (CR2/CR4/CR8), enabling flexible per-turn compute allocation in multi-turn interactions while avoiding wasted computation and the need to rebuild history states after model switching.
